lesson_title: Albert Einstein Was a Dope(愛因思坦)

words.definition_en: A medical condition causing pain and stiffness in joints and muscles.
words.sentence_en: He joked that his joint pain was just a mild case of rheumatism.
words.sentence_tw: 他開玩笑說他的關節痛只是一個輕微的風濕病例。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「風濕病」。年長者常患的關節肌肉疼痛病症。
words.timing: 談論關節疼痛或年長者常見病症時。

words.definition_en: Dark or poorly lit; feeling distressed or pessimistic.
words.sentence_en: The classroom felt gloomy on rainy Monday mornings.
words.sentence_tw: 在下雨的週一早晨，教室讓人感到陰暗沉悶。
words.analysis: 形容詞，意為「陰暗的；抑鬱的；陰沉的」。形容天氣或心情沉悶低落。
words.timing: 形容天氣陰霾或心情低落時。

words.definition_en: Unconventional and slightly strange in behavior or appearance.
words.definition_tw: 古怪的/怪異的/特立獨行的
words.sentence_en: People thought the scientist was eccentric because he never wore socks.
words.sentence_tw: 人們認為這位科學家很古怪，因為他從不穿襪子。
words.analysis: 形容詞/名詞，意為「古怪的；怪異的；行為特立獨行的人」。常用於形容天才特別的習性。
words.timing: 描述某人行為舉止與眾不同或怪異時。

words.definition_en: Rightfully earned or merited because of actions or qualities.
words.sentence_en: Einstein received a well-deserved Nobel Prize for his contributions to physics.
words.sentence_tw: 愛因斯坦因對物理學的貢獻而獲得了實至名歸的諾貝爾獎。
words.analysis: 形容詞/動詞過去式，意為「應得的；理所當然的」。
words.timing: 談論努力獲得應有回報或獎項時。

words.definition_en: Cause something to change direction; turn aside.
words.sentence_en: Gravity can deflect light coming from distant stars.
words.sentence_tw: 引力可以使來自遙遠恆星的光線發生偏折。
words.analysis: 動詞，意為「使偏斜；轉向；轉移（注意力或光線）」。故事中指引力使光線彎曲偏折。
words.timing: 談論光線、方向改變或物理引力作用時。

words.definition_en: Having one's attention completely absorbed by something.
words.definition_tw: 全神貫注的/沉溺其中的
words.sentence_en: He was so engrossed in his physics equations that he forgot to eat lunch.
words.sentence_tw: 他太全神貫注於物理方程式，以至於忘了吃午飯。
words.analysis: 形容詞，意為「全神貫注的；沉溺其中的」。形容專心致志到忽視周遭。
words.timing: 形容人極度專心投入某事時。

words.definition_en: Disorganized and incapable of serious, connected thought.
words.definition_tw: 注意力不集中的/心不在焉的/丟三落四的
words.sentence_en: Although brilliant, he seemed scatterbrained in his daily personal routine.
words.definition_tw: 儘管才華橫溢，他在日常個人生活中似乎總是心不在焉。
words.analysis: 形容詞，意為「注意力不集中的；心不在焉的；丟三落四的」。
words.timing: 形容人做事迷糊或不夠專注時。

words.definition_en: Having or showing a habitual forgetfulness or inattention.
words.sentence_en: The absentminded professor used a bank check as a bookmark and lost it.
words.sentence_tw: 這位健忘的教授把銀行支票當作書籤，結果把它弄丟了。
words.analysis: 形容詞，意為「心不在焉的；健忘的」。愛因斯坦經典的典型形象。
words.timing: 形容人常常健忘或分心時。

words.definition_en: In a state of peaceful happiness and satisfaction.
words.sentence_en: He was content with a simple sweater, his violin, and a sheet of paper.
words.sentence_tw: 他只要有一件簡單的毛衣、他的小提琴和一張紙就心滿意足了。
words.analysis: 形容詞，意為「心滿意足的；滿足的」。不追求奢華、對簡單生活感到滿意。
words.timing: 表達知足常樂或生活安逸時。

words.definition_en: A comic performer who uses physical humor; a foolish person.
words.sentence_en: He loved to stick out his tongue and clown around for photo journalists.
words.sentence_tw: 他喜歡向攝影記者吐舌頭並耍寶開玩笑。
words.analysis: 名詞/動詞，意為「小丑；愛開玩笑的人；扮小丑」。
words.timing: 談論愛開玩笑或滑稽舉動時。

words.definition_en: Wrinkled, creased trousers made of thick ribbed cotton fabric.
words.sentence_en: He comfortably walked into the university wearing rumple corduroy pants.
words.sentence_tw: 他穿著一條皺巴巴的燈心絨長褲，舒適地走進了大學。
words.analysis: 短語，意為「皺巴巴的燈心絨長褲」。描述愛因斯坦招牌的不修邊幅穿著風格。
words.timing: 形容不修邊幅的衣著風格時。

words.definition_en: Unable to see distant objects clearly; myopic.
words.sentence_en: Being nearsighted, he needed glasses to read the blackboard clearly.
words.definition_tw: 因為近視，他需要戴眼鏡才能看清黑板。
words.analysis: 形容詞，意為「近視的；缺乏遠見的」。看近清楚、看遠模糊的視力狀態。
words.timing: 談論視力狀況或近視時。

words.definition_en: Having or showing a lack of common sense or seriousness; playful.
words.sentence_en: He often made silly faces to make children laugh.
words.sentence_tw: 他經常做出滑稽的面部表情來逗孩子笑。
words.analysis: 形容詞，意為「傻氣的；滑稽可笑的；無聊的」。
words.timing: 形容滑稽、逗趣的行為時。

words.definition_en: A marine mammal producing loud, sharp vocal sounds.
words.sentence_en: The unique laugh of the professor sounded like a barking seal.
words.sentence_tw: 這位教授獨特的笑聲聽起來像是一隻吠叫的海豹。
words.analysis: 短語，意為「吠叫的海豹」。用於生動形容某種獨特洪亮叫聲或咳嗽聲。
words.timing: 形容獨特的笑聲或聲音時。

words.definition_en: Einstein enjoyed performing or showing off in front of audiences.
words.definition_tw: 愛因斯坦是個愛搶鏡頭、愛表演的人
words.sentence_en: Whenever cameras appeared, people realized that Einstein was a ham.
words.sentence_tw: 每當相機出現時，人們意識到愛因斯坦其實很愛搶鏡頭表演。
words.analysis: 短語（俚語 ham 意為愛表演/搶鏡頭的人），意為「愛因斯坦是個愛搶鏡頭、愛表演的人」。
words.timing: 描述某人喜歡在鏡頭前表現自己時。

words.definition_en: The slow, deliberate movement of a beetle insect.
words.sentence_en: He watched a beetle crawl on his blanket and wondered about space and movement.
words.sentence_tw: 他看著一隻甲蟲在他的毛毯上爬行，並對空間與運動產生了好奇。
words.analysis: 短語，意為「甲蟲爬行」。用來比喻極其緩慢爬行或觀察甲蟲在彎曲表面移動的童年經歷。
words.timing: 觀察緩慢移動的小生物時。

words.definition_en: A remarkable fact or event that can be observed and studied.
words.definition_tw: 現象/罕見非凡的人事物
words.sentence_en: Light bending around massive objects was a mind-boggling phenomenon.
words.sentence_tw: 光線繞過巨大質量物體彎曲是一個令人匪夷所思的現象。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「現象；罕見非凡的人事物」。科學界觀察到的自然現象。
words.timing: 探討科學或自然界的特殊現象時。

words.definition_en: The art of making three-dimensional figures out of stone, wood, or metal.
words.sentence_en: Artists created a bronze sculpture to honor his scientific achievements.
words.sentence_tw: 藝術家們創作了一座青銅雕塑來紀念他的科學成就。
words.analysis: 名詞/動詞，意為「雕塑品；雕刻」。
words.timing: 談論藝術品或雕刻創作時。

words.definition_en: A dramatic work combining singing, orchestral music, and acting.
words.sentence_en: In his free time, he enjoyed listening to classical opera and playing music.
words.sentence_tw: 在空閒時間，他喜歡聆聽古典歌劇並演奏音樂。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「歌劇」。愛因斯坦熱愛的古典音樂藝術形式之一。
words.timing: 談論古典音樂或欣賞歌劇時。

words.definition_en: Declare one's public approval or support of; sign a document.
words.sentence_en: Companies offered him large sums of money to endorse their commercial products.
words.sentence_tw: 許多公司提供他一大筆錢，希望他為他們的商業產品代言。
words.analysis: 動詞，意為「代言；背書；公開支持；簽署」。
words.timing: 談論商業代言或公開支持某事物時。

words.definition_en: A large or sufficient amount or quantity; abundance.
words.sentence_en: Don't worry, there is plenty of time to solve this physics puzzle.
words.sentence_tw: 別擔心，有充足的時間來解決這個物理難題。
words.analysis: 名詞/副詞/形容詞，意為「大量；充足；豐富」。
words.timing: 表達數量充足或綽綽有餘時。

words.definition_en: Removing one's clothing.
words.sentence_en: He was so distracted that he started undressing for bed in the middle of the afternoon.
words.sentence_tw: 他太心不在焉了，居然在下午時分就開始準備脫衣服上床睡覺。
words.analysis: 動詞/分詞，意為「脫衣服」。
words.timing: 描述準備就寢或脫去衣物時。

words.definition_en: Take off one's clothes.
words.sentence_en: He forgot where he was and began to undress right in his study.
words.sentence_tw: 他忘記自己身在何處，直接在書房裡開始脫衣服。
words.analysis: 動詞，意為「脫衣」。原形動詞。
words.timing: 描述脫掉衣物的動作時。

words.definition_en: A fan who pursues famous people to get their signature.
words.sentence_en: Everywhere he went, an autograph seeker would jump out with a pen.
words.sentence_tw: 無論他走到哪裡，總會有索取簽名的粉絲拿著筆衝出來。
words.analysis: 短語，意為「索取簽名的人；簽名迷」。跟著成名後的愛因斯坦到處跑的人群。
words.timing: 名人遇到粉絲索取簽名時。

words.definition_en: Harassed, pursued, or nagged persistently.
words.definition_tw: 被緊追不捨的/被纏得煩不勝煩的
words.sentence_en: The famous scientist was constantly hounded by curious reporters.
words.sentence_tw: 這位著名的科學家經常被好奇的記者們窮追不捨。
words.analysis: 形容詞/動詞過去式，意為「被緊追不捨的；被纏得煩不勝煩的」。
words.timing: 形容被媒體或人群緊追不捨時。

words.definition_en: A short documentary film of news events shown in theaters.
words.sentence_en: People watched newsreel footage of the famous genius visiting America.
words.sentence_tw: 人們觀看了這位著名天才訪問美國的新聞紀錄短片。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「新聞紀錄短片」。電視普及前在電影院播放的影像新聞紀錄。
words.timing: 談論早期電影院播出的新聞短片時。

words.definition_en: A remarkable concurrence of events without apparent causal connection.
words.sentence_en: It was a pure coincidence that both scientists published their ideas in the same year.
words.sentence_tw: 兩位科學家在同一年發表他們的觀念，這純粹是個巧合。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「巧合；偶然一致」。兩件無關的事同時發生。
words.timing: 發生意料之外的巧合時。

words.definition_en: An event where the moon passes between the sun and Earth, blocking sunlight.
words.sentence_en: Scientists photographed the solar eclipse of 1919 to test Einstein's theory.
words.sentence_tw: 科學家們拍攝了1919年的日食以檢驗愛因斯坦的理論。
words.analysis: 短語，意為「日食；日全蝕」。證實廣義相對論關鍵的天文現象。
words.timing: 談論天文奇觀或日食現象時。

words.definition_en: Mad, eccentric, or foolish (informal).
words.definition_tw: 古怪瘋狂的/古里古怪的
words.sentence_en: Some teachers mistakenly thought his unconventional ideas were completely nutty.
words.sentence_tw: 有些老師誤以為他那些非傳統的想法簡直瘋狂透頂。
words.analysis: 形容詞（口語），意為「古怪瘋狂的；古里古怪的」。
words.timing: 形容想法極端瘋狂或怪異時。

words.definition_en: An eccentric or foolish person with bizarre ideas.
words.definition_tw: 怪人/狂人/想法荒謬的人
words.sentence_en: Critics initially dismissed his bold relativity paper as the work of a crackpot.
words.sentence_tw: 批評家們最初對他大膽的相對論論文不屑一顧，認為是一個怪人的作品。
words.analysis: 名詞/形容詞（口語），意為「怪人；狂人；想法荒謬異想天開的人」。
words.timing: 形容不被主流接受的怪異狂人時。

words.definition_en: Propose formally for a award, honor, or official position.
words.sentence_en: Colleagues voted to nominate him for the Nobel Prize in Physics.
words.sentence_tw: 同事們投票提名他競逐諾貝爾物理學獎。
words.analysis: 動詞，意為「提名；推薦」。官方推薦角逐獎項。
words.timing: 談論獎項提名或候選人推薦時。

words.definition_en: Causing someone to feel ashamed, embarrassed, or foolish.
words.definition_tw: 令人羞辱的/使人難堪的
words.sentence_en: Failing the entrance exam on his first try was a humiliating experience.
words.sentence_tw: 第一次入學考試不及格是一次令人難堪的經歷。
words.analysis: 形容詞，意為「令人羞辱的；使人難堪的」。極度令人丟臉的場合。
words.timing: 遭遇難堪或丟臉的經歷時。

words.definition_en: Form a circle around; surround completely.
words.sentence_en: The equator is an imaginary line that can encircle the Earth.
words.sentence_tw: 赤道是一條可以環繞地球的假想線。
words.analysis: 動詞，意為「環繞；圍繞；圈住」。把事物包圍一圈。
words.timing: 描述環繞、包圍某物時。

words.definition_en: An imaginary line drawn around the earth equally distant from both poles.
words.sentence_en: If you travel along the equator, you stay in the tropical zone.
words.sentence_tw: 如果你沿著赤道旅行，你就會留在熱帶地區。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「赤道」。劃分地球南北半球的虛構緯線。
words.timing: 談論地理位置或赤道時。

words.definition_en: Thought of or produced a new thought or solution.
words.sentence_en: While riding his bicycle, he came up with an idea that changed physics forever.
words.sentence_tw: 騎腳踏車時，他想出了一個永遠改變物理學的點子。
words.analysis: 短語（過去式），意為「想出了一個點子／靈感」。頭腦中萌生新構想。
words.timing: 突然獲得靈感或想出新點子時。

words.definition_en: Hold firmly; comprehend or understand fully.
words.sentence_en: It took years for other scientists to fully grasp his theory of relativity.
words.sentence_tw: 其他科學家花了多年時間才完全理解他的相對論。
words.analysis: 動詞/名詞，意為「抓住；理解；領悟」。理解複雜艱深的理論。
words.timing: 完全理解複雜概念或理論時。

words.definition_en: A group of atoms bonded together, representing the smallest unit of a chemical compound.
words.sentence_en: Water is made of molecules containing hydrogen and oxygen.
words.sentence_tw: 水是由包含氫和氧的分子所組成的。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「分子」。由原子組成的微觀物質基本單位。
words.timing: 談論化學或微觀結構時。

words.definition_en: The basic unit of a chemical element.
words.sentence_en: Einstein proved the existence of atoms mathematically.
words.sentence_tw: 愛因斯坦從數學上證明了原子的存在。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「原子」。構成化學元素的微觀基本粒子。
words.timing: 談論物理學或原子結構時。

words.definition_en: Take off vertically from a launchpad (as a rocket).
words.sentence_en: Spacecraft use immense energy to blast off into outer space.
words.sentence_tw: 太空船利用巨大的能量發射升空進入外太空。
words.analysis: 動詞短語，意為「（火箭）升空；發射點火起飛」。描述航天器快速發射。
words.timing: 火箭發射或太空船升空時。

words.definition_en: Catch or enclose in a place; a device for catching animals.
words.sentence_en: A black hole's gravity is so strong that it can trap light.
words.sentence_tw: 黑洞的引力是如此強大，以至於它能困住光線。
words.analysis: 動詞/名詞，意為「陷阱；困住；捕獲」。強大的引力連光都能捕捉困住。
words.timing: 談論被禁錮或陷阱捕捉時。

words.definition_en: The force that attracts a body toward the center of the earth or another heavy object.
words.sentence_en: He explained gravity not as a force, but as the bending of space-time.
words.sentence_tw: 他對重力的解釋不是一種力，而是時空的彎曲。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「地心引力；重力」。萬有引力。
words.timing: 談論物理重力或引力現象時。

words.definition_en: Completely fill to overflowing; study intensively in a short time.
words.definition_tw: 塞滿/臨時抱佛腳死記硬背
words.sentence_en: He hated having to cram facts for school exams just to pass.
words.sentence_tw: 他討厭為了應付學校考試而死記硬背各種事實。
words.analysis: 動詞，意為「塞滿；臨時抱佛腳死記硬背」。考試前死記硬背資料。
words.timing: 考試前臨時抱佛腳或死記硬背時。

words.definition_en: Feet covered in perspiration.
words.definition_tw: 容易出汗的雙腳／流汗的腳
words.sentence_en: He stopped wearing socks because he complained they got sweaty feet wet.
words.sentence_tw: 他不再穿襪子，因為他抱怨襪子會讓流汗的雙腳變得濕漉漉的。
words.analysis: 短語，意為「容易出汗的雙腳／流汗的腳」。愛因斯坦討厭穿襪子的原因之一。
words.timing: 談論腳部流汗或不穿襪子的原因時。

words.definition_en: Gnarled, enlarged veins, most commonly appearing in the legs.
words.sentence_en: Standing for long hours at a chalkboard can aggravate varicose veins.
words.sentence_tw: 長時間站在黑板前可能會加重靜脈曲張。
words.analysis: 短語，意為「靜脈曲張」。腿部常見的血管腫脹膨大疾病。
words.timing: 談論久站造成的腿部血管疾病時。

words.definition_en: Intense, sharp, and deep brown eyes that seem to look right through someone.
words.sentence_en: He stared out at the universe with his piercing brown eyes.
words.sentence_tw: 他用他深邃銳利的棕色雙眼凝視著宇宙。
words.analysis: 短語，意為「深邃銳利的棕色雙眼」。形容目光睿智銳利透徹。
words.timing: 形容眼神銳利或深刻時。

words.definition_en: Hair that has gentle curves and forms natural S-shapes.
words.sentence_en: His wild wavy hair stuck out in all directions.
words.sentence_tw: 他那蓬亂的捲髮朝四面八方亂翹。
words.analysis: 短語，意為「捲曲的頭髮；波浪髮」。愛因斯坦招牌炸開蓬鬆的捲髮。
words.timing: 描述頭髮捲曲蓬鬆的外觀時。

words.definition_en: A violent shattering or blowing apart with a loud noise; sudden outburst.
words.sentence_en: The equation E=mc² showed how much energy an atomic explosion produces.
words.sentence_tw: 公式 $E=mc^2$ 展示了原子爆炸會產生多大的能量。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「爆炸；爆發；突發事件」。核能或原子彈的巨大爆炸能量。
words.timing: 談論爆炸威力或核能反應時。

words.definition_en: A certificate awarded by an educational institution to show completion of study.
words.sentence_en: He eventually finished high school in Switzerland and earned his diploma.
words.sentence_tw: 他最終在瑞士完成了高中學業並取得了畢業證書。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「畢業證書；文憑」。畢業獲得的學位證書。
words.timing: 談論學業完成或畢業證書時。

words.definition_en: The sport or activity of navigating a sailboat.
words.sentence_en: He loved going sailing on quiet lakes, even though he didn't know how to swim.
words.sentence_tw: 他喜歡在寧靜的湖泊上開帆船，儘管他不會游泳。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「航海；駕帆船」。愛因斯坦最喜愛的放鬆休閒運動。
words.timing: 談論水上休閒活動或航海時。

words.definition_en: Strongly attracted and interested; spellbound.
words.sentence_en: Young Albert was fascinated by the magnetic compass his father gave him.
words.sentence_tw: 年輕的亞伯特對父親送給他的磁羅盤深深著迷。
words.analysis: 形容詞，意為「著迷的；深深被吸引的」。對事物抱有極大的好奇心。
words.timing: 形容對某事物充滿興趣與好奇時。

words.definition_en: A foolish, unstylish, or socially awkward person; an overly intellectual fan.
words.definition_tw: 書呆子/科技控/沉迷學問的人
words.sentence_en: Before he became famous, some kids called him a quiet nerd.
words.sentence_tw: 在他成名之前，有些孩子叫他安靜的書呆子。
words.analysis: 名詞（口語），意為「書呆子；科技控；沉迷學問的人」。
words.timing: 形容沈浸於學術或科技的書呆子時。

words.definition_en: Giving food particles to birds in public parks.
words.sentence_en: In his later years in Princeton, he enjoyed sitting on park benches feeding pigeons.
words.sentence_tw: 在普林斯頓的晚年，他喜歡坐在公園長椅上餵鴿子。
words.analysis: 短語，意為「餵鴿子」。描繪晚年悠閒生活散步的場景。
words.timing: 描述公園悠閒的退休生活時。

words.definition_en: A female domestic servant.
words.sentence_en: The house maid helped keep the messy study somewhat organized.
words.sentence_tw: 家裡的幫傭協助將凌亂的書房整理得稍微有條理。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「女傭；打掃女侍」。家庭打掃幫傭。
words.timing: 談論家務幫傭或清理房間時。

words.definition_en: A private teacher, typically one who teaches a single student or small group.
words.sentence_en: A medical student worked as a tutor to teach Albert advanced mathematics.
words.sentence_tw: 一名醫學生擔任家庭教師，教導亞伯特高等數學。
words.analysis: 名詞/動詞，意為「家庭教師；私人導師」。輔導課業的教師。
words.timing: 談論私人家教或課業輔導時。

words.definition_en: Uncontrolled outbursts of anger and frustration, typically in a young child.
words.sentence_en: As a young child, Albert had severe temper tantrums and threw things at his sister.
words.sentence_tw: 小時候，亞伯特經常嚴重發脾氣，甚至向姊姊丟東西。
words.analysis: 短語，意為「發脾氣；耍態度暴怒」。幼年情緒失控砸物品。
words.timing: 形容小孩情緒失控或大發雷霆時。

words.definition_en: A person who does not eat meat or fish.
words.sentence_en: Later in life, he decided to become a strict vegetarian for health and moral reasons.
words.sentence_tw: 晚年時，基於健康和道德原因，他決定成為一名嚴格的素食者。
words.analysis: 名詞/形容詞，意為「素食者；素食的」。不吃肉類的飲食習慣。
words.timing: 談論飲食習慣或素食主義時。

words.definition_en: Relating to or associated with Jews or Judaism.
words.sentence_en: Because he was Jewish, he had to leave Germany when the Nazi party rose to power.
words.sentence_tw: 因為他是猶太人，當納粹黨掌權時他不得不離開德國。
words.analysis: 形容詞，意為「猶太人的；猶太教的」。民族與宗教背景。
words.timing: 談論猶太民族或宗教背景時。

words.definition_en: In a manner unaffected by gravity; floating effortlessly.
words.definition_tw: 無重力地/失重地/輕飄飄地
words.sentence_en: In a free-falling elevator, a person would float weightlessly.
words.sentence_tw: 在自由落體的電梯裡，人會無重力地漂浮著。
words.analysis: 副詞，意為「無重力地；失重地；輕飄飄地」。形容失重狀態下的懸浮。
words.timing: 形容無重力漂浮狀態時。

words.definition_en: An event in which people compete for a prize; dispute.
words.sentence_en: He entered a mathematics contest and easily solved every puzzle.
words.sentence_tw: 他參加了一場數學競賽，並輕鬆解開了每一個謎題。
words.analysis: 名詞/動詞，意為「競賽；比賽；爭奪」。角逐勝負的活動。
words.timing: 參與競技比賽或數學競賽時。

words.definition_en: Give or grant as an official payment, prize, or reward.
words.sentence_en: The committee decided to award him the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics.
words.sentence_tw: 委員會決定授予他1921年的諾貝爾物理學獎。
words.analysis: 名詞/動詞，意為「獎項；頒發；授予」。官方頒發榮譽。
words.timing: 談論頒獎或獲得榮譽獎項時。

words.definition_en: Einstein's theory concerning space, time, and gravity.
words.sentence_en: The General Theory of Relativity revolutionized how we view space and time.
words.sentence_tw: 廣義相對論徹底革新了我們對空間和時間的看法。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「相對論」。愛因斯坦最出名的物理學巨作。
words.timing: 談論物理學相對論時。

words.definition_en: Change something radically or fundamentally.
words.definition_tw: 徹底改革/顛覆/給…帶來革命性變化
words.sentence_en: His famous equations helped revolutionize modern science.
words.sentence_tw: 他著名的方程式幫助徹底革新了現代科學。
words.analysis: 動詞，意為「徹底改革；顛覆；給…帶來革命性變化」。徹底改寫歷史領域。
words.timing: 談論重大創新或徹底變革時。

words.definition_en: The scientific study of plants.
words.sentence_en: While he excelled in physics, he showed little interest in botany.
words.sentence_tw: 雖然他在物理學方面表現優異，但他對植物學卻興趣缺缺。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「植物學」。研究植物結構與生的科學。
words.timing: 談論自然科學或植物學科時。

words.definition_en: The scientific study of the behavior, structure, and classification of animals.
words.sentence_en: Zoology deals with animal life, whereas Einstein focused on physical forces.
words.sentence_tw: 動物學研究動物生命，而愛因斯坦則聚焦於物理力學。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「動物學」。研究動物生命與行為的科學。
words.timing: 談論動物學研究時。

words.definition_en: Fail an exam, course, or test (informal).
words.sentence_en: He did not flunk math, contrary to popular urban legends.
words.sentence_tw: 與普遍的都市傳說相反，他並沒有數學不及格。
words.analysis: 動詞（口語），意為「不及格；考砸；當掉」。考試未達到通過標準。
words.timing: 考試不及格或被當掉時。

words.definition_en: You are crazy, irrational, or foolish (informal phrase).
words.definition_tw: 你瘋了/你真神經／不可理喻
words.sentence_en: When he told people time could slow down, they replied, 'You're nuts!'
words.sentence_tw: 當他告訴人們時間可以變慢時，他們回答說：「你瘋了！」
words.analysis: 短語（口語），意為「你瘋了；你真神經／不可理喻」。形容極度瘋狂異想天開。
words.timing: 認為別人的想法瘋狂不可理喻時。

words.definition_en: Expressing something clearly or formally.
words.sentence_en: He published a paper stating that light travels in tiny energy quanta.
words.sentence_tw: 他發表了一篇論文，明確指出光是以微小的能量量子傳播的。
words.analysis: 動詞/分詞，意為「陳述；明言；發表說明」。明確發言發表理論。
words.timing: 正式發表聲明或說明觀點時。

words.definition_en: The branch of mathematics concerned with the properties and relations of points, lines, and shapes.
words.sentence_en: At age twelve, Albert taught himself Euclidean geometry over one summer.
words.sentence_tw: 十二歲時，亞伯特利用一個夏天自學了歐幾里得幾何學。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「幾何學」。愛因斯坦少年時期深深著迷的數學分支。
words.timing: 談論數學分支或幾何學時。

words.definition_en: Foolish or stupid; slow-witted (informal).
words.definition_tw: 傻乎乎的/反應遲鈍笨拙的
words.sentence_en: Because he spoke slowly as a child, some thought he was dopey.
words.sentence_tw: 因為他小時候說話很慢，有些人以為他反應遲鈍。
words.analysis: 形容詞（口語），意為「傻乎乎的；反應遲鈍笨拙的」。
words.timing: 形容人傻氣或反應慢半拍時。

words.definition_en: A stupid person; a mannequin or model.
words.sentence_en: Strict teachers unfairly labeled young Albert a dummy.
words.sentence_tw: 嚴格的老師不公平地給年輕的亞伯特貼上了笨蛋的標籤。
words.analysis: 名詞（口語），意為「笨蛋；傻瓜；木頭人」。
words.timing: 被輕蔑地稱作笨蛋或傻瓜時。

words.definition_en: The branch of mathematics in which symbols and letters are used to represent numbers.
words.sentence_en: His uncle introduced him to algebra, calling it a game where you hunt for 'X'.
words.sentence_tw: 他的叔叔將代數介紹給他，稱其為一場尋找「X」的遊戲。
words.analysis: 名詞，意為「代數學」。用符號運算數字的數學分支。
words.timing: 談論代數運算或數學科目時。
